items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That was the last time I remember recording with him. He was the bass player.

ctx.x: Either Herbie Lewis or James Leary?
James Leary. That’s who was on that. He was the bass player. That was the last time I remember recording with him. I don’t remember anything in New York. You got something we did in New York?

Yeah. That’s this one, and then we’ll come back to the one in San Francisco. This one is Natural Illusions. This one looks like – it’s got a full violin section and really fleshed out woodwinds. Could you for the record – it’s got Phil Bodner on it – could you pronounce Romeo – is it Pen-que [two syllables] or Penque [one]?
